name: Money
description: A household's money (not a business's books): transactions, budgets, investments and goals. Set overviewLead: spending (budget, running costs) or netWorth (investments).

settings.label: What the Overview leads with: "spending" (this month's spending: a budget or running-costs app), "netWorth" (investments and wealth), or "auto" (net worth once real holdings are added). Set it from what the app is for

for: A household's money: what came in and what went out, by category
Monthly budgets per category, spent against the limit
Investments and holdings with their value and change
Savings goals with a target and a date
notFor: A business's books or GST invoicing (use invoices)
